additional_info.subject: 0414661 - ID0414661-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2 / S4 313659082001] Software-Update (C1) CRM:00314000152
additional_info.body:
Good morning Jose,
I am reaching out regarding ticket
ID0414661
.
This child case was opened for issues on updating charger
CZe7EW.
An OTA update to v6.1.3 was launched on Monday 24.03.2025 but failed.
As a consequence, the charger went for one day in Failsafe mode, as the communication to router XF4 was temporarily lost. A reboot restored the charger, as most likely XF4 needed a power cycle. Yesterday I rolled out via SSH FW v6.1.3 to the charger and completed the update. No issue on XF4 when the charger booted up.
As the charger is now up and running on v6.1.3, I will proceed to close this ticket.
